Class ServerController

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.server.controller.ServerController
All Implemented Interfaces:
EndGameObserver, RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>
public class ServerController extends Object implements RequestVisitor<VirtualClient>, EndGameObserver
Top-level server controller. Manages all active games and all connected clients.

Implements RequestVisitor to handle lobby-level requests (login, logout, game creation/join). Game-specific requests are forwarded to the appropriate GameController. A periodic timeout checker pings clients every pingRatioMs ms and disconnects those silent for more than clientTimeoutMs ms.

    • startTimeoutChecker

      public void startTimeoutChecker(int pingRatioMs, long clientTimeoutMs)
      Starts the background timeout checker on a single-threaded scheduler. Clients that have not pinged within clientTimeoutMs ms are forcefully disconnected.
      Parameters:
      pingRatioMs - polling interval in milliseconds
      clientTimeoutMs - inactivity threshold in milliseconds

    • handleHostDisconnection

      public void handleHostDisconnection(int gameId) throws ServerException
      Evicts all clients still in the lobby of the given game when the host disconnects. Each evicted client is moved back to the home screen.
      Parameters:
      gameId - the game whose host has disconnected
      Throws:
      ServerException - if forwarding the exit request to the game fails

    • recoverGames

      public void recoverGames()
      Loads persisted game states from disk and re-registers them as RecoverState instances, waiting for players to reconnect. Called once at server startup.
